tranche: Q5 new source families (audio DSP review, hosted-bot talents, patent prompts, building-energy multi-agent, Japanese novel/manga workspace, Unity editor CLI)
source_role: original-author source discovered in GitSkills G2 (dynamic discovery; not a registered source)
review_kind: exact-pinned 10-dimension static source-vetting candidate decisions (not governed review)
review_method: Parallel read-only reviewers on disjoint exact package lists with one shared brief (see docs/reviews/2026-11-03-q5-six-new-source-families-static.md); package files read at the pin except where coverage says otherwise; SKILL.md matched case-insensitively; integration owner validated identity against git ls-tree, taxonomy, score/rationale agreement and hard-fail/disposition consistency, applied the 10/20 floor, and applied family harmonizations by independent adjudicators (openclaw, patent prompts, monogatari). Nothing executed, installed or fetched from candidates.
macro_findings: 18 read-only review/explainer skills for audio DSP, numerics, real-time safety and plugin formats (JUCE, VST3, AU, CLAP, WebAudio, YUP, game audio); no consequential actions, network calls or credentials; root Unlicense.

Accuracy defects: VST3 mode constant that does not exist and restartComponent attributed to the processor; ValueTree listener thread misstated in juce-review SKILL.md (its reference is correct); a 'GOOD' MIDI example that drops events; stale Wwise/FMOD class and callback names and a misordered struct; SIMD loops without remainder handling; bilinear warping attributed to low instead of near-Nyquist cutoffs.

Several review skills make sibling skills (audio-dsp-review, audio-numerics-review) a required first step; they exist at the pin but are outside each package. Two skills instruct proactive unrequested flagging (over-triggering).

audio-dsp-review ships an unattributed real-time spin-mutex implementation closely matching a published third-party design; provenance could not be verified from this host, so it is recorded as misattribution-suspected (REJECT) pending confirmation.
Repository README installs via an unpinned main-branch download and bootstrap script (outside the packages; recorded only).

reconciliation_overrides.reason: Reviewer flagged license-conflict for an unattributed audio_spin_mutex implementation in references/realtime-violations.md (three-stage {5,10,3000} spin, ten batched _mm_pause, single yield) that matches a published third-party design from memory; the upstream page was unreachable from this host (network policy), so the copy is unverified. Flag recorded as misattribution-suspected (unverified provenance) instead of license-conflict; REJECT unchanged pending provenance confirmation.

records.name: yup-review
records.package_tree_identity_basis: git tree SHA of the package directory at the pin, read from a full clone with git ls-tree
records.source_license_scope: Root LICENSE blob fdddb29aa445bf3d6a5d843d6dd77e10a9f99657 (Unlicense text) at the pin; package-local terms in package_license_finding
records.package_license_finding: root Unlicense (public domain dedication) only; no package-level LICENSE/ATTRIBUTION/NOTICE; no copied third-party text detected (original BAD/GOOD examples; JUCE/Steinberg/W3C API names used nominatively)
records.dependencies: None executable; Step 0 requires sibling skills audio-dsp-review and audio-numerics-review (present at pin outside package); references audio-dsp-review/references/realtime-violations.md Section 2 (present). YUP framework version unstated.
records.purpose_and_nontrigger: Review YUP plugin code for AudioParameterHandle misuse, gesture/notification on audio thread, bus-layout guards, flush/state recall and CLAP try-lock issues. Not for JUCE APVTS code; review-only.
records.content_finding: Framework-specific checks (handle lifecycle, CLAP try-lock around getProcessLock, flush on CLAP reset) add value beyond generic real-time review. The MidiBuffer 'GOOD' example clears the buffer and re-adds only generated note-offs, silently dropping all original MIDI events, and MidiBuffer::addEvent after clear may still allocate; numbering errors and unpinned YUP API reduce reliability.
records.bundled_file_findings: references/yup-violations.md (10.7 KB): BAD/GOOD C++ for handle init in prepareToPlay, no setValueNotifyingHost on audio thread, no String/Logger in processBlock, bounded voice pool, MidiBuffer rewrite, CriticalSection/spinlock, channel guards, reset/flush, state save/load. Two sections both numbered 7. No scripts.
records.authority_and_privacy_finding: Read-only code review: the procedure only reads user-supplied plugin code and writes a review report; no file writes, builds, installs, network calls, posting or credential/private-data access. No consequential actions, so no confirmation gate is needed.
records.capability_specific: YUP plugin parameter-handle, lifecycle and wrapper review
